summary: Circle Internet Group filed an 8-K disclosing a September 17, 2026 private placement to Binance of 1,237,011 Class A shares at $80.84 for $100 million gross, at a discount to the prior market price, plus a five-year expansion of their Binance USDC partnership superseding November 2024 and August 2025 agreements. Binance pays no premium; Circle pays a monthly incentive fee tied to USDC held via Circle's Modular Smart Contract Wallet. Binance is lock-up restricted for two years or earlier termination. Watch dilution, Binance concentration risk, and lock-up overhang.
